brief.zh: 没有任何已知，证出「下雨 → (刮风 → 下雨)」。
brief.en: With nothing given, prove “it rains → (it is windy → it rains)”.

hint.zh: 两个 →，两个框：外面的框假设「下雨」，里面的框假设「刮风」。里面要的结论，外面已经假设了。
hint.en: Two →s, two boxes: the outer one assumes “it rains”, the inner one “it is windy”. What the inner box must conclude, the outer one has assumed.

t.zh: 已经成立的事，加上什么条件都还成立。这句话叫 K；只有公理、没有框的证明器，只能把它当作不用证的出发点。
t.en: What holds still holds under any extra condition. This sentence is called K; a prover with axioms and no box can only take it as a starting point that needs no proof.

t.zh: 有了框，它可以证出来。框里可以再放框，里面的框看得见外面框的假设。
t.en: With boxes it can be proved. A box can sit inside a box, and the inner one sees the outer one’s assumption.

after.zh: 一次套用都没用。证出来以后，这块电路是元件 K：元件上选两句话，它直接给出「如果 第一句，那么（如果 第二句，那么 第一句）」。
after.en: Not one Apply. Proved, this circuit becomes the part K: choose two sentences on its part and it gives “if the first, then (if the second, then the first)” at once.
